slice: WAV-CHUNK-003/WAV-SCAN-004 exact proof slice (Range regression only; not the whole Issue)

environment.memory_measurement: /usr/bin/time -v wrapping each cargo kani invocation; not per-solver cgroup isolation

input_domain.wav_chunk_003: full numeric domain of offset:u64, file_len:u64, size:u32; no input narrowing assume. offset>file_len is a production-unreachable total extension classified as terminal trailing
input_domain.wav_scan_004: initial offset 12; file_len:u64 with file_len>=12 as exact RIFF/WAVE constructor precondition; chunk sizes are full u32. Small scan model covers inputs that reach terminal/invalid after at most 3 valid chunks; 4+ valid chunks remain outside the bounded model
input_domain.riff_constructor_bound: not assumed. The proof domain is stronger than the constructor-admitted RIFF file length domain

assumptions.assumption: boundary proof has no input narrowing assume
scan proof valid_steps <= 3 after four potential header interpretations
one-step measure decrease may be composed mathematically with finite file length
assumptions.classification: human composition only; not machine-proved unbounded termination

coverage.boundary_exact_complement: Advance iff header available, body_end addition does not overflow, body_end<=file_len, pad-inclusive next_offset does not overflow and stays within file_len. Invalid is the exact header-available complement; Terminal is exact header-unavailable complement. Complete is offset==file_len; otherwise trailing.
coverage.scan_small_model: four potential symbolic u32 size fields are unrolled. Inputs with 0..3 valid chunks before terminal/invalid are covered exactly within the declared bound, including an invalid fourth header after three valid chunks. Inputs accepting a fourth valid chunk are excluded and remain unproven.
coverage.measure: every valid step advances by at least 8 bytes and strictly decreases file_len-offset. The finite unrolled model checks transition composition; induction over unbounded chunk count is not claimed as a Kani-proved result.

wav_range_regression.note: Range proofs were not redesigned or reimplemented; this lane is a regression for the wav.rs change.

connection_conditions.production_caller: wav_layout uses wav_scan_position before reading each 8-byte header, passes offset/file_len/size to wav_chunk_step, uses Advance.body_start for fmt reads and Advance.next_offset for scan update
connection_conditions.error_mapping: internal boundary enum maps to the pre-existing MediaError::malformed strings; public API signatures, error precedence, supported formats, duplicate semantics, normal/error behavior, and f64 precision are unchanged
connection_conditions.true_to_code: proofs invoke production helpers directly. No cfg(kani) replacement, fmt/alloc stub, Cursor, Read+Seek, Vec decode, writer fixture, or diagnostic formatting is in the proof target

unproven_scope: duplicate fmt/data and unknown chunk semantics
machine-proved termination for unlimited chunk counts

boundary.change: temporary pad omission: let pad = size & 1 -> let pad = 0
boundary.scan_proof_result: passed in this mutation lane, showing that the padding oracle belongs primarily to the boundary proof

mutation.post_revert: mise run test al-media and mise run test-formal passed after complete revert; final wav-chunk-scan lane passed

runner.instrumentation: per-harness elapsed_ms, raw log, verdict, GNU time max RSS when available
runner.full_lane: not part of this slice because legacy whole-call proofs have established timeouts; selective assurance groups are the required evidence

cost_comparison.legacy_trial: decode_wav_never_panics_signed timeout at 1200s cap/elapsed 1265s/3.8GiB; wav_frame_count_never_panics_signed timeout at 600s cap/elapsed 632s/2.6GiB; wav_reads_never_panics_unsigned timeout at 300s then 900s caps/elapsed 316s/949s and 1.2->3.1GiB (evidence/al274/verification.md)
cost_comparison.legacy_canonical: al274 canonical lane timed out all three at 1500s/proof. The later fmt-stub canonical representative run recorded wav_reads_never_panics_unsigned peak RSS 13762MiB while still timing out; verdict was not obtained
cost_comparison.new: wav-chunk-scan final lane total elapsed 14514ms; boundary 6922ms/288164KiB, scan 7592ms/300376KiB
cost_comparison.rerun_cost: selective wav-chunk-scan lane is seconds-scale in this environment and far below the 10-20 minute design target. This is a limited chunk/scan comparison, not the complete old/new cost matrix

proptest_overlap.relationship: proptest/regression exercise public integration statistically or concretely; Kani proves local pure boundary/scan arithmetic exhaustively within the declared domains

legacy_disposition: No legacy whole-call proof was retired in this slice. Chunk/scan replacement proofs are additive; retire decisions remain for a later slice with coordinator approval and replacement coverage.
rf_reduction: Candidate only: a reusable RIFF chunk boundary walker contract may belong in Ruviform after the contract is separated from AudioLens scan/error semantics. No Ruviform issue was filed or updated.
